title: A Mars Trip Could Strip 30% of Hip Bone Density
hook: Mars sounds adventurous until it costs 30% of hip bone density.
closing: Long missions need protection because floating removes the loading that keeps skeletons strong.
question: Would this change your Mars plans?

segments.say: Astronaut bone density can fall 1.5 percent monthly because space removes normal skeletal loading.
Astronaut hip density can drop 2.2 percent monthly, making weight-bearing bone especially vulnerable.
A Mars mission could cost 30 percent of hip bone density without protection, turning countermeasures into survival equipment.
